results.text: Daily HDR Blog | HDR One Magazine | Facebook | Twitter | Pinterest | Google+ Travel Diary Day 12 (Travel Blog - strange-lands.com/daily/2012/07/24/sitting-on-a-car-at-br...) 3:oo am came sooner than expected. Our flight was at 6 am. I knew we’d have problems getting to the airport. We’d asked the hotel to book us a taxi. To hotel staff in Bali, tourists are little more than walking wallets and they’ll find any way to make money from you. We made it clear to them that we wanted a metered taxi, no Notre Dame Basilica in HDR (7628816096)
